join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter links on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Link filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set subsmaylink on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!permit random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!permit random
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!permit
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !permit <user>

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send

twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "e47c3f9a-c573-4044-afd1-c7750936b9d2"}
handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=e47c3f9a-c573-4044-afd1-c7750936b9d2 chatter-display=Random :check out my cool website! example.com
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, please ask a moderator before posting links - warning

clock_forward 3h


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!permit @random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random may now post one link within 5 minutes.

clock_forward 10m

twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "a3ef435b-13b8-4701-9e6e-4fe75241a2dc"}
handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 message-id=a3ef435b-13b8-4701-9e6e-4fe75241a2dc chatter-display=Random :check out my cool website! example.com
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Random, please ask a moderator before posting links - warning


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!permit @Random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random may now post one link within 5 minutes.

clock_forward 30s

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :check out my cool website! example.com
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Link permitted. (Random)

twitch_delete_chat_message {"BroadcasterID": 1, "ModID": 999, "Tok": {"access_token": "some-access-token", "token_type": "bearer", "refresh_token": "some-refresh-token", "expiry": "2050-10-01T03:11:00Z"}, "ID": "cdac822c-e6f5-4eda-ac42-e239cb71ab83"}

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!permit random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random may now post one link within 5 minutes.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!permit random
send hortbot #foobar [HB] random may now post one link within 5 minutes.

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :check out my cool website! example.com
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Link permitted. (Random)

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random access=subscriber :check out my cool website! example.com
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter links off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Link filter is now disabled.

send hortbot #foobar [HB] Link filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now disabled.

no_send
